tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Find open-weight AI models by name or task (chat, coding, agentic, vision, reasoning). Returns each model's slug, size, context length and licence; use the slug with hardware_for_model.

tools.name: find_hardware
tools.description: List graphics cards or complete machines (Macs, mini PCs) sold in a market, with memory, bandwidth, the estimated speed on a model and a link to each one's page and prices. Filter by minimum memory and new or used; sort by speed or popularity.

tools.name: hardware_details
tools.description: One graphics card or machine in a market: its specifications, which models it runs fully in memory at a context length and how fast, and a link to its page and prices.

tools.name: hardware_for_model
tools.description: For one model: how much memory it needs at each context length, and the fastest hardware (and the fastest Mac) that runs it fully in memory in a market, with their speeds. Links the model's page, which shows the cheapest and best-value picks with prices.

tools.name: best_hardware
tools.description: The ranked 'best for local AI' lists of a market (all graphics cards, cards under a price, used cards, Macs and mini PCs): best first by the most capable model each runs fully in memory. Prices are on each list's page.

tools.name: compare_hardware
tools.description: Two graphics cards or machines side by side in a market: memory, bandwidth, how many models each runs fully in memory, and the estimated speed of each on every model.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "find_hardware" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: market, kind, min_memory_gb, condition, model, context, sort, limit

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_hardware" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
